info.name: FlipStar App API
info.description:
The endpoints the FlipStar web and mobile apps call. Admin, staff-only and setup endpoints are left out; `FlipStar-API.postman_collection.json` has everything.

Generated by introspecting the Django URL resolver, so every route here is one the application actually serves.

## Setup
1. `baseUrl` points at staging (https://api.uat.flipstar.et). Change it, or pick an environment, for another server.
2. Log in with **Authentication > POST auth login with phone** (phone + 6-digit password). The token is saved to the `token` collection variable.
3. Every other request sends `Authorization: Token {{token}}`.

## Encrypted endpoints
Requests carrying the `X-FlipStar-Encrypted` header go to endpoints that only accept the encrypted transport. The collection handles it: its pre-request script fetches the server's public key (cached in `serverPublicKey`), seals the body you wrote and adds `X-Client-Public-Key`; its test script opens the encrypted reply. Read the decrypted reply in the request's **Visualize** tab or the Postman Console. Write bodies as plain JSON, as shown.

`clientSecretKey` is this collection's own test keypair, made on first use. Clear it before sharing an exported copy.

## Notes
- Auth is DRF Token, not Bearer/JWT.
- App passwords are exactly 6 digits.
- The webhook folders are what Telebirr and TIMWE call, not the apps. Sending them changes subscription and payment state, so use them only on staging.
